{{Top|leg}}
A '''sonic damper field''' was a type of field that enabled those within to talk privately without concern that their conversation could be overheard. The public tables at the flower market in [[Makrin City]] on [[Shelkonwa]] had built-in sonic damper fields to facilitate private haggling.
